Just a volunteer with Autism wanting this to raise money for Animal Charities. I volunteer for the RSPCA doing 'Animal Care' which has helped me cope with life. And I thought I would try and give back. 

 I will upload videos and shorts

If you feel like supporting this channel and the animals you can at http://www.patreon.com/c/AnimalCharityChannel
